subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` permanently expose a current-session-only deferred reset capability for successful after-compaction hooks?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API with session-state authority; code review can assess mechanics, but only the hook-surface owner can approve the contract and its long-term support boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped API
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require public documentation and focused contract coverage, then merge after complete real lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep resets owner-internal
options.body: Decline the public hook API and keep session recovery inside the owning context engine or core lifecycle policy instead.

options.title: Pause for a broader design
options.body: Hold this PR while consolidating compaction recovery, session reset outcomes, and plugin lifecycle capabilities into a separately approved API design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped API
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require public documentation and focused contract coverage, then merge after complete real lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the original compaction/reset hook contract being extended.
